Fixed double-tap seeking jumping too far or overriding your manual seeks when resuming an episode
Redesigned the player's exit, server switch and subtitle panels with a fresh frosted-glass look
The home screen quote now highlights the character name and anime title
Smoother, lighter home feed with faster loads and fewer dropped frames
Lower memory use and smaller install size (fonts bundled instead of downloaded)
Default streaming provider is now controllable from the app's remote config (first provider wins)
Faster episode and details screens with lighter visuals
General stability improvements across the player and watch history
